items.title: Simulating microplastic distribution in oceans: the impact of morphology and sources
items.title_en: Simulating microplastic distribution in oceans: the impact of morphology and sources
items.title_zh: 模拟海洋中微塑料的分布：形态与来源的影响
items.summary_en: Microplastics are widespread in the ocean with known accumulation hotspots in the subtropical gyres, yet their horizontal and vertical distribution is not fully understood. Microplastics are found under various shapes and sizes, reflecting multiple sources. This morphological variability influences their ocean distribution and hence needs to be considered in global models. Here, we studied the influence of microplastic morphology on its global oceanic distribution with the global numerical model NEMO/PISCES-PLASTIC. We explicitly simulated the ocean distribution of microplastics of different morphologies (fibres versus fragments) reflecting their source categories (laundry and household dust fibres, personal care products, car tyre wear, fragments from larger objects) and source vectors (rivers and continental runoff). Our results demonstrate that accounting for the variability in microplastics vertical behaviour linked with their morphology significantly influences the global spatial distribution and budgets of microplastics. Furthermore, our results indicate that fibres, that constitute a large proportion of the primary MPs, are the dominant microplastics in the mesopelagic layer (100–1000 m water depth). Finally, global microplastic budget derived from our model simulations show that it is essential to consider in situ fragmentation of macroplastics into microplastics to reconcile the latest assessment of microplastic sources in the ocean with existing estimates of the ocean microplastic budget. These conclusions have strong implications for marine plastic pollution assessments and mitigation measures.
items.summary_zh: 微塑料在海洋中广泛存在，已知在亚热带环流区存在富集热点，但其水平和垂直分布尚不完全清楚。 微塑料呈现出各种形状和大小，反映了其多元化的来源。这种形态上的多样性影响着它们在海洋中的分布，因此在全球模型中需要予以考虑。在此，我们利用全球数值模型NEMO/PISCES-PLASTIC，研究了微塑料形态对其全球海洋分布的影响。 我们针对不同形态（纤维与碎片）的微塑料进行了显式模拟，这些形态反映了其来源类别（洗衣和家庭灰尘中的纤维、个人护理产品、汽车轮胎磨损、较大物体的碎片）以及来源途径（河流和大陆径流）。 研究结果表明，考虑与形态相关的微塑料垂直行为的变异性，会显著影响微塑料的全球空间分布和物质通量。 此外，我们的结果表明，纤维作为初级微塑料的主要组成部分，是中层海域（水深 100–1000 米）中占主导地位的微塑料。 最后，基于本研究模型模拟得出的全球微塑料收支表明，为使最新的海洋微塑料来源评估与现有的海洋微塑料收支估算相一致，必须考虑宏观塑料在原位碎裂成微塑料的过程。这些结论对海洋塑料污染评估和减缓措施具有重要意义。

items.title: Structural contradictions in Turkish climate policy
items.title_en: Structural contradictions in Turkish climate policy
items.title_zh: 土耳其气候政策中的结构性矛盾
items.summary_en: This letter critically examines Turkish climate policy through the lens of structural contradiction and policy incoherence. Rather than viewing the gap between stated climate goals and domestic action as mere implementation failure, I argue that key components of Turkey’s climate policy, including its nationally determined contributions, paradoxical energy strategy, and diplomatic positioning, constitute a framework of contradictory commitments. By projecting an image of climate ambition while simultaneously maintaining mechanisms that sustain a fossil fuel-dependent economic model, Turkish climate policy reflects a structural orientation aimed at managing competing domestic economic interests and international pressures. This analysis deconstructs the rhetoric and strategies employed, revealing a fundamental disconnect between stated intentions and tangible outcomes. As Turkey prepares to co-host the COP31 climate summit alongside Australia this year, dissecting and addressing these contradictions is an urgent necessity to foster genuine climate leadership, since such contradictions ultimately delay meaningful decarbonization, lock the country into high-carbon infrastructure, and will make a future just transformation towards sustainability significantly more costly and difficult to achieve.
items.summary_zh: 本文从结构性矛盾和政策不连贯的角度，对土耳其的气候政策进行了批判性考察。我认为，将既定的气候目标与国内行动之间的差距视为单纯的执行失败是不恰当的；相反，土耳其气候政策的关键组成部分——包括其国家自主贡献、自相矛盾的能源战略以及外交定位——共同构成了一个充满矛盾的承诺框架。 土耳其的气候政策一方面展现出气候雄心的形象，另一方面却维持着支撑化石燃料依赖型经济模式的机制，这反映出其结构性取向旨在平衡相互冲突的国内经济利益与国际压力。本分析通过解构其采用的言辞与策略，揭示了既定意图与实际成果之间存在的根本脱节。 随着土耳其今年准备与澳大利亚共同主办COP31气候峰会，剖析并解决这些矛盾已成为培养真正气候领导力的当务之急，因为此类矛盾最终将延缓实质性的脱碳进程，使该国陷入高碳基础设施的困境，并导致未来向可持续性迈进的公正转型付出更高昂的代价且更难实现。

items.title: Spatially heterogeneous pathways linking atmospheric dryness to deep soil moisture
items.title_en: Spatially heterogeneous pathways linking atmospheric dryness to deep soil moisture
items.title_zh: 将大气干湿度与深层土壤水分联系起来的空间异质性路径
items.summary_en: Atmospheric vapor pressure deficit (VPD) has intensified under global warming, yet its influence on soil moisture across depths remains unclear. Using multiple global monthly soil moisture datasets spanning the past decades, we combined pairwise and conditional Granger causality analyses to disentangle pathways linking VPD to surface (0–28 cm, surface soil moisture (SSM)) and deep (28–100 cm, deep soil moisture (DSM)) soil moisture. We identify widespread statistical directional dependence from VPD to both SSM and DSM, whereas the reverse relationships from soil moisture to VPD are comparatively weak. Across global land areas, we identified significant VPD–DSM relationships that remained after conditioning on SSM, here termed SSM-independent pathways, which were concentrated mainly in the mid- to high-latitude regions of the Northern Hemisphere and dominated in most forest and savanna ecosystems. Regions with SSM-independent pathways exhibit significantly higher vegetation greenness and evapotranspiration than neighboring SSM-mediated regions. Our findings reveal spatially heterogeneous patterns of land–atmosphere coupling and suggest an important role for vegetation-mediated water use in linking VPD to DSM variability.
items.summary_zh: 在全球变暖背景下，大气水蒸气压缺口（VPD）有所加剧，但其对各深度土壤水分的影响尚不明确。 我们利用过去几十年间的多套全球月度土壤含水量数据集，结合成对和条件格朗杰因果分析，厘清了VPD与表层（0–28厘米，表层土壤含水量（SSM））及深层（28–100厘米，深层土壤含水量（DSM））土壤含水量之间的关联路径。 我们发现，从 VPD 到 SSM 和 DSM 均存在广泛的统计方向性依赖关系，而从土壤水分到 VPD 的反向关系则相对较弱。 在全球陆地范围内，我们发现了显著的VPD与DSM之间的关系，这些关系在对SSM进行条件处理后仍然存在，此处称为SSM独立路径，主要集中在北半球的中高纬度地区，并在大多数森林和稀树草原生态系统中占主导地位。 具有SSM独立路径的区域，其植被绿度和蒸散量均显著高于邻近的SSM介导区域。我们的研究结果揭示了陆地-大气耦合的空间异质性模式，并表明植被介导的水利用在将VPD与DSM变异性联系起来方面发挥着重要作用。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01936-2Restoration initiatives are important for progress towards climate and biodiversity policy goals; however, whether they lead to the displacement of tree loss elsewhere (leakage effect) is still unclear. This study examines the leakage impacts of restoration projects in sub-Saharan Africa.

items.title: Shielded but unprepared: quantifying the safe-development paradox in ice-jam flood risk management
items.title_en: Shielded but unprepared: quantifying the safe-development paradox in ice-jam flood risk management
items.title_zh: 有防护却未做好准备：量化冰塞洪水风险管理中的“安全与发展悖论”
items.summary_en: Ice-jam floods pose a critical threat to northern riverine communities due to their rapid onset, unpredictability, and potential to exceed historical open-water flood levels. While structural solutions like artificial ice breaking can mitigate immediate risks, long-term resilience relies heavily on household-level adaptation. However, many existing models fall short in capturing the complexity of human behavior, often depending on simplified or theoretical assumptions. This study enhances the Dynamic Ice-jam Flood Risk Assessment framework by integrating the Transtheoretical Model (TTM) of behavior change, using empirical data from Fort McMurray, Alberta. Shapley regression was applied to identify the relative influence of behavioral drivers—such as perceived risk, cost, self-efficacy, perceived response efficacy, prior flood experience, and social networks—on transitions through the TTM stages of change. These findings were incorporated into an agent-based model coupled with the RIVICE hydrodynamic model to simulate twelve policy scenarios blending structural interventions and behavioral strategies. Scenario simulations suggest that while structural measures can reduce overall flood risk by more than 70%, they also lead to a ∼60% decline in household-level adaptation efforts. Conversely, behavioral interventions tailored to the population’s readiness to act achieved household adoption rates of up to 18.5% of households (a 106% relative increase from the 9.0% baseline), albeit with smaller impacts on flood exposure. These results highlight the need for integrated policy approaches that balance physical risk reduction with strategies that sustain individual and collective adaptation. Subject to local recalibration, the framework offers a transferable pathway for cold-region flood adaptation policy.
items.summary_zh: 冰塞洪水因其突发性强、难以预测且洪水水位可能超过历史上的开水期洪水水位，对北部河流沿岸社区构成了严重威胁。虽然人工破冰等结构性解决方案可以缓解眼前的风险，但长期的韧性在很大程度上取决于家庭层面的适应能力。 然而，许多现有模型在捕捉人类行为的复杂性方面尚有不足，往往依赖于简化的或理论性的假设。本研究利用阿尔伯塔省麦克默里堡的实证数据，将行为改变的“跨理论模型”（TTM）融入“动态冰塞洪水风险评估”框架，从而对其进行了完善。 研究应用夏普利回归分析，识别了行为驱动因素（如风险感知、成本、自我效能感、应对效能感知、既往洪水经历及社交网络）对通过跨理论模型（TTM）各阶段转变的相对影响。 将这些研究结果纳入基于代理的模型，并与RIVICE水动力模型相结合，模拟了十二种融合结构性干预与行为策略的政策情景。情景模拟表明，虽然结构性措施可将总体洪水风险降低70%以上，但也会导致家庭层面的适应努力减少约60%。 相反，针对居民行动准备度量身定制的行为干预措施，使家庭采用率最高达到18.5%（较9.0%的基准值相对增长106%），尽管其对洪水暴露程度的影响较小。 这些结果凸显了制定综合政策措施的必要性，这些措施应在降低物理风险与维持个人及集体适应能力的策略之间取得平衡。在进行本地化调整的前提下，该框架为寒冷地区洪水适应政策提供了一条可推广的实施路径。

items.title: Atmospheric rivers drive compound flooding potential along the U.S. West Coast
items.title_en: Atmospheric rivers drive compound flooding potential along the U.S. West Coast
items.title_zh: 大气河流加剧了美国西海岸的复合性洪涝风险
items.summary_en: Atmospheric rivers (ARs) are a major driver of hydrometeorological extremes along the U.S. West Coast, yet their role in generating events with high compound flood potential remains poorly understood and quantified. Here, we assess the contribution of ARs to compound flood potential by analyzing the joint occurrence of extreme rainfall (RF) and non-tidal total water levels (nTWL) across coastal catchments in the study region. Compound events are defined as co-occurring exceedances of RF and nTWL thresholds, and a copula-based framework is used to estimate joint exceedance probabilities. Results show that the number of compound events along the Washington and Oregon coasts is nearly twice as high as that of southern California. ARs are associated with 58%–72% of these compound events and contribute more than 90% to joint exceedance probabilities for both moderate (e.g. 2 year return period) and extreme (e.g. 100 year return period) events. These findings demonstrate that compound flood potential along the U.S. West Coast is largely governed by AR-driven precipitation occurring concurrently with wave-driven coastal water levels, highlighting the importance of multi-driver interactions in flood risk assessments.
items.summary_zh: 大气河流（ARs）是美国西海岸水文气象极端事件的主要驱动因素，但其在引发具有高复合洪水风险的事件中的作用仍未得到充分理解和量化。 本文通过分析研究区域内沿海集水区极端降雨（RF）与非潮汐总水位（nTWL）的联合发生情况，评估了大气河流对复合洪水风险的贡献。 复合事件被定义为极端降雨（RF）和非潮汐总水位（nTWL）同时超过阈值的情况，并采用基于Copula的框架来估算联合超限概率。结果表明，华盛顿州和俄勒冈州沿海地区的复合事件数量几乎是南加利福尼亚州的两倍。 其中58%–72%的复合事件与AR相关，且无论对于中等强度（例如2年重现期）还是极端强度（例如100年重现期）的事件，AR均对联合超限概率的贡献率超过90%。 这些发现表明，美国西海岸的复合洪水风险主要受随波浪驱动的海平面变化同时发生的、由AR驱动的降水所主导，这突显了多驱动因素相互作用在洪水风险评估中的重要性。

items.title: The night sky is getting 10% brighter every year. We’re forgetting what darkness feels like
items.title_en: The night sky is getting 10% brighter every year. We’re forgetting what darkness feels like
items.title_zh: 夜空的亮度每年都在增加10%。我们正在遗忘黑暗的感觉
items.summary_en: If more cities start regulating outdoor lighting, we humans could make the environment better for all living creaturesEvery night, I can turn off the lights in my room – but I can’t do anything about the outdoor lights in the walkway or parking lot that leak through the curtains. Living in Portland, where the night is still illuminated by street lights, porch lights and parking lot glare, I forgot what it actually feels like to sleep in darkness.I was excited when I realized my travels to a residency in south-east Oregon would show me a sky I hadn’t experienced in decades. In the Oregon outback, part of the International Dark Sky Places network, I would be surrounded by 2.5m acres of unpolluted night in every direction. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 如果更多城市开始对户外照明进行规范管理，我们人类就能为所有生物创造更好的环境。每晚，我虽然可以关掉房间里的灯——但对于透过窗帘渗入室内的走廊或停车场里的户外灯光，我却无能为力。 生活在波特兰，这里的夜晚依然被路灯、门廊灯和停车场的刺眼光芒照亮，我已经忘记了在完全黑暗中入睡究竟是怎样的感受。当我意识到，前往俄勒冈州东南部参加驻留项目将让我重见几十年来未曾体验过的夜空时，我感到非常兴奋。 在俄勒冈州的偏远地区——这里是“国际暗夜保护区”网络的一部分——我将被四面八方2.5百万英亩的无光污染夜空所环绕。继续阅读……
